emergencyshelter.report.title: Emergency Shelter · Launch Report
emergencyshelter.report.all_good: All mod dependencies are satisfied. No mods were skipped this launch.
emergencyshelter.report.summary: %s mod(s) were temporarily skipped because of dependency problems. You can still enter your worlds.
emergencyshelter.report.reason.HEALED: Failed during the previous launch and was disabled automatically: %s
